children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may rise to $7.82-3/4 per bushel, as it is about to break a resistance at $7.64.
A wave C from $6.45 has  briefly travelled above its 86.4% projection level of $7.64 again. It is highly likely to extend to the 100% level of $7.82-3/4.
Condition is, the contract has to maintain above the support at $7.50-1/4. A bearish target of $7.30-1/4 will be established if the market breaks the support.

On the daily chart, the current rise looks like an extension of the uptrend from the December 17, 2025 low of $5.57-1/4. The rise is driven by a wave C, which has travelled above $7.51-3/4, its 100% projection level.
The projection analysis suggests an extension of this wave to the 138.2% level of $8.13-1/2.
